functions.name: chat_with_claimbot
functions.title: Chat with ClaimBot
functions.description: Send a conversation message to the ClaimBot assistant and get a reply. Pass the full message history as an array of {role, content} objects (role is 'user' or 'assistant'). Optionally provide a session_id to persist the transcript and persist: true to save it. Use this when an AI client needs the in-app bot's compliant, knowledge-grounded answer about accident claims.

messages.description: The conversation history. Must be a non-empty array.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier used to persist and retrieve the conversation transcript.

persist.description: When true and session_id is set, the transcript is saved to BotConversation.

functions.name: ingest_lead
functions.title: Ingest a new lead
functions.description: Run the full lead capture pipeline (validate, normalize, create Lead record, run calculated fields, fire webhooks) for a new accident claim lead. At least one of email or mobile is required. Accepts canonical lead fields such as first_name, last_name, email, mobile, zip_code, accident_type, accident_state, incident_date, injured, injury_type, treatment, medical_bills, lost_wages, fault, attorney, qualification_status, source, source_ref, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, and consent fields. Unknown fields are stored on the lead's custom_fields.

email.description: Contact email. At least one of email or mobile is required.

mobile.description: Contact phone number. At least one of email or mobile is required.

accident_state.description: Two-letter US state code where the accident occurred.

functions.name: fire_webhooks
functions.title: Fire webhooks for a lead
functions.description: Dispatch webhook deliveries for a given lead and event. Loads the lead, runs calculated fields, selects matching enabled webhooks, builds payloads, and delivers with retries. Use dry_run: true to preview the resolved payloads without sending anything.

lead_id.description: The Lead record id to fire webhooks for.

webhook_id.description: Restrict delivery to a single webhook by id.

dry_run.description: When true, no delivery is sent; the resolved payloads are returned for inspection.

functions.name: publish_scheduled_posts
functions.title: Publish scheduled blog posts
functions.description: Publishes blog posts whose status is 'scheduled' and whose publish_at time has passed, skipping any with unresolved compliance flags. Safe to call repeatedly; only moves scheduled to published. Intended to run on a schedule but can be triggered manually.

functions.name: run_calculated_fields
functions.title: Run calculated fields on a lead
functions.description: Runs the calculated-fields engine against a lead. With lead_id only, it runs and persists the results. With dry_run: true it returns the trace without persisting. With a sample object it runs against ad-hoc values (dry-run). With field_id it restricts to a single calculated field.

lead_id.description: The Lead record id to run against. Mutually exclusive with sample.

sample.description: Ad-hoc lead values to run against (dry-run only). Mutually exclusive with lead_id.

dry_run.description: When true, results are returned without persisting.

field_id.description: Restrict the run to a single CalculatedField by id or token.
